posts.text: Great result for The Bach yesterday with a 4 - 1 home win over Wolverhampton Casuals - HOME again next Saturday against Widnes, let’s get a big crowd down to show our support in numbers 💪👊🏻
We hear from Dec and JKD after today’s 4-1 victory. https://t.co/1tvOCj8ias

FT here and Bach secure a 2nd win of the week with an important 4 1 win against league leaders going in to today’s fixtures Wolves Cassies, with goals from Hatton, Williams,  Birchall and Nolan.  The team grafted for the pts and move on to a home game against Widnes next week

🔵⚪️ v 🟢🟢

Sandbach United v Wolverhampton Casuals 

And it’s 4 1 as Birchall sets up Kieran Nolan who finds the bottom of the corner with his shot from the edge of the box, what a tiger 🐅 😆 in the box he is.

4 1
